notes:
Source: 2023 (73rd) GSC Final Report, Anonymity-Protected Digital Edition (157 PDF pages). Rosters: Conference Committees PDF p.147 (printed 146), 2024 chairs table + Trustees' Committees + GSB officers p.148, Conference Members (trustees, nontrustee directors, newly elected) pp.149-152, Area Delegates pp.153-154, nonvoting attendees / AAWS & AAGV directors / GSO & Grapevine staff p.155, Delegates Bid Farewell p.156. Delegate chair Tami L. (Area 78, Panel 72) from the opening narrative and Greetings; general manager Robert (Bob) W.; Sandra W. is Director of Staff Services.
NAMES: every person is first name + last initial. Class A trustees and nonalcoholic GSO employees are printed with full surnames in this edition and were reduced to first name + initial (Linda C., Judith Ann K., Kerry M., Al M., Andie M. [bio: Anadora "Andie"], Molly O., Kevin P.; GSO employees Paul K. (CFO), Zenaida (Zenny) M. (Controller), Michelle M. (Archivist)); titles (Sr., Hon.) and professional suffixes dropped; no full surnames are stored anywhere in this file. Trustees use the short form printed in the committee/officer lists (Jimmy D., Francis G., Trish L., Marita R.); the longer bio forms (James (Jimmy) D., Francis H. G., Patricia (Trish) L., Marita Hagen R.) are kept in "printed_name". Delegates use the Area Delegates list spelling everywhere (e.g. Kathleen (Kathy) R., Michael (Mike) B., Cheryl (Sherry) S., William (Bill) F., Jeffrey (Jeff) S., Kenneth (Ken) T.; committee-roster short forms kept as "printed_name" on committee members); next-year Agenda chair printed "Becca H." is recorded as Rebecca H. The general manager is recorded as "Bob W." (printed "Robert W." in the AAWS directors list, "Robert (Bob) W." in the department report).
DELEGATES: 93 areas, 45 Panel 72 (second year, rotating) and 48 Panel 73 (first year). Area 26: the Area Delegates list misprints "Jennifer J., Bardstown, IN"; the 2023 Corrections roster, the 2022 delegates list and 2022 Area highlight give Jennifer S. (Bardstown, KY) - name reconciled to Jennifer S. (printed_name kept), city kept as printed. Area 35 city printed "Biwabik, ND" kept as printed. Area 89: status "alternate" - Jocelyne C., alternate AREA CHAIR (not the alternate delegate), was seated because neither the Panel 73 delegate Giséle V. nor the alternate delegate could attend (pre-Conference Policy/Admissions recommendation); the Agenda committee roster still prints "Gisele V. - Area 89" and is kept as printed (member has seated_substitute "Jocelyne C."), which produces the validator WARNING "AGENDA: area 89 member name 'Gisele V.' vs delegate 'Jocelyne C.'" - explained, not an error.
CONFERENCE COMMITTEES: 11 primary + 2 secondary (Archives, International Conventions/Regional Forums, footnote 1 = secondary assignment). Every primary committee has exactly one * chair and one ** alternate chair, and Archives/ICRF also have one of each. Area 1 delegate Tomy G. (Panel 73) is missing from every printed committee list; he is the 2024 Literature chair in the 2024 chairs table and appears on the 2024 Final Report's Literature roster (Panel 73) together with the same three Panel 73 Literature members as 2023 (Pete B., James O., Crystal S.), so he was added to LITERATURE as a member with "inferred": true. A stray "J" printed after "Area 7, Northern Interior CA" (and after "International Conventions" in the trustees' ICRF secretary line) is a typesetting artifact and was ignored. Tami L. (delegate chair) is listed on Report and Charter without a mark. Finance secretary printed as "Zenny" + surname (nonalcoholic) and Archives secretary Michelle + surname (nonalcoholic), both reduced. ICRF printed "Secretaries: James H., Sandra W." -> secretary James H. plus "secretaries" list. No trustees/directors appear inside the Conference committee lists.
TRUSTEES' COMMITTEES: the asterisk on the "2023 Trustees' Committees*" heading refers to the ex-officio footnote (GSB chair/interim chair on all committees; GSO general manager on all but Audit, Compensation, Nominating) - NOT a secondary assignment, so secondary=false for all; the "secondary committee assignment" footnote that the text extraction places nearby belongs to the 2024 chairs table (Archives*, ICRF*). Josh E. appears "(thru Feb. 2023)" on Archives, Compensation, Nominating (chair) and GSB Sharing Session (chair) - kept with type as printed and a note. ** = Appointed Committee Member (Amalia C. on Literature; Morgan B., Kirk H. on PI); *** = consultant (Gerry C., Tom P. on CPC/T&A). CPC/T&A: roster secretary Michael R.; staff report names Misha Q. co-secretary (co_secretary). ICRF: Sandra W. interim secretary (International Conventions), James H. secretary (Regional Forums). Finance & Budgetary secretary Zenaida (Zenny) M. (Controller); Audit/Compensation secretary Paul K. (CFO).
TRUSTEES: 21 listed = 7 Class A (incl. Linda C., GSB chair, "thru Jan. 2023") + 14 Class B (incl. Josh E., general service trustee, "thru Feb. 2023"; both resigned - see narrative p.3-4). Rotating (*): Jimmy D. (Southwest), Francis G. (Northeast), Trish L. (Trustee-at-large/Canada). trustee_committees are derived from the Trustees' Committees roster; bios differ in places (Molly O.'s bio also lists Archives; Kevin P.'s bio lists International; Cathi C.'s bio lists Finance; Deborah K.'s bio lists Audit and "consultant on the Compensation Committee"; Mike L.'s bio says "consultant on the Audit and Compensation Committees"; Judith Ann K. bio matches) - roster used. elected_year taken from the 2023 bios except: Francis G. 2019 (2023 bio says only "serves as"; from 2019-2021 Final Reports), Josh E. 2020 (2022 Final Report), Linda C. null (elected GSB chair following the 2021 Conference per 2021/2022 reports, not as a trustee election year). past_delegate area recorded only when stated (Reilly K. 58, Deborah K. 51, Mike L. 24 as printed, Carolyn W. 79); Cathi C. area 23 inferred from "Area 23 archivist" after rotating; others' areas not stated -> null. board_roles: GSB officers from the officers box, AAWS/AAGV membership from the directors lists (p.155); Jimmy D. also "Interim GSB chair" (Nominating report: chair office vacant, "currently filled on an interim basis by Jimmy D."; he signs the GSB report "Interim Chair"; the farewell narrative says "Acting GSB Chair"). gsb_officers includes an extra "Interim Chair" entry for Jimmy D. (not in the printed officers box) with a note. Class A seat vacant on the post-Conference slate.
NONTRUSTEE DIRECTORS: Vera F., Clinton M., John W. (AAWS); Cindy F., Coree H., David S. (Grapevine). No director is marked rotating; David S. "served as Grapevine director from April 2022-2023" and was elected general service trustee following the Conference; Coree H. is also leaving the AAGV board (Nominating report: search underway "to fill the vacancy left by Coree H."; not on the post-Conference AAGV slate) - rotating kept false as printed, with a note.
NEWLY ELECTED (by the GSB following the 2023 Conference): Class B trustees Teresa J. (Southwest), Robert L. (Trustee-at-large/Canada), David S. (printed "(see above)" with no position - general service trustee per the 2023 Trustees/AAGV slates and the 2024 report), Ken T. (Northeast; not the Area 45 delegate Kenneth (Ken) T.); AA Grapevine nontrustee directors Teddy B.-W., Morgan B. (class null for directors).
STAFF: GSO staff list (11) with assignments from the Conference/trustees' committee secretary lines and the Staff Reports (Conference, CPC, Treatment/Accessibilities & Remote Communities, Corrections, Group Services, International, International Convention, Literature, Nominating, Public Information, Staff Coordinator). Grapevine staff: Paola M. (La Viña editor), Jon W. (senior editor; Conference Grapevine/La Viña secretary) plus Chris C. (AAGV publisher, from the AAGV directors list; he is among the "15 GSO, Grapevine and La Viña staff members" = 11 GSO staff + GM + 3 GV/LV). Nonvoting resource attendees (GSO department employees) are not recorded.
farewell_count: not stated as a number (the farewell narrative says "farewells from the Panel 72 departing delegates"); 45 Panel 72 delegates are in the list -> null per schema.
Conference: April 23-29, 2023, New York Marriott at the Brooklyn Bridge, Brooklyn, NY; 133 Conference members (93 delegates, 25 trustees and directors, 15 staff).
